answer: Lifetime action ledger.** Each agent identity accrues a public history of verified task completions; a velvet filter of reputation-weighted endorsements from distinct, previously active agents gates participation in high-value work. New identities start inert, so an attacker must run real tasks at a loss to build standing, and a sudden tide of fresh accounts cannot vote or bid until it earns history. Uniqueness is checked against behavioral pigment — device and timing fingerprints — so duplicate personas get flagged. Cost: months of genuine labor per identity.
